commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.

90+4' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
90+2' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) sends the corner into the box, but Guglielmo Vicario intercepts it and averts the threat.
90+1' Emerson (West Ham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. West Ham have a corner.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Substitution. Brennan Johnson did his best and is replaced by Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham).
89' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. John Brooks had an easy-decision to make.
88' The resulting corner from Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is cleared.

87' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Tottenham win a corner kick.
86' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) leaps highest to meet the resulting set piece and sends his header way off target.
86' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) prepares to take a corner kick.
86' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
84' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
84' Michail Antonio (West Ham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Guglielmo Vicario, who smothers the ball.
83' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
82' Ange Postecoglou prepares a substitution. Timo Werner is replaced by Richarlison (Tottenham).
82' Substitution. Yves Bissouma makes his way off the pitch and Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) comes on as his replacement.

74' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. John Brooks had an easy-decision to make.
72' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
72' Timo Werner (Tottenham) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Tottenham will take a corner.
70' Ange Postecoglou decides to make a substitution. James Maddison will be replaced by Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham).
70' Substitution. Pape Matar Sarr in, Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) out.
69' The goalkeeper pulls off a save to deny Pedro Porro (Tottenham), whose low effort is only aimed at the middle of the goal.
68' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) latches onto a loose ball inside the box, but his first-time strike at goal is blocked by a defender.
66' The linesman raises his flag. Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) is adjudged offside.
65' Close! Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
62' Rough tackle by Jarrod Bowen (West Ham). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
61' John Brooks shows a yellow card to Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) for his blatant foul.
61' Michail Antonio (West Ham) pounces on the cross and fires in a shot on goal from close range, but Guglielmo Vicario is alert and makes a decent save.

57' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) controls a great pass from Jarrod Bowen on the edge of the box, steadies himself but his poor effort goes yards over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.

55' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
53' Michail Antonio (West Ham) has tested the patience of referee John Brooks and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
52' James Maddison (Tottenham) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.

51' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
49' West Ham are ruled offside.
49' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) will deliver the corner kick.
48' A snap shot by Michail Antonio (West Ham) from mid-range towards the middle of the goal catches Guglielmo Vicario flat footed, but he somehow recovers and makes a brilliant save.
46' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when John Brooks blows for a foul.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.

45+2' James Maddison (Tottenham) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
45+2' The corner from Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is cleared away by the defence.
45+1' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Tottenham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) was quite harsh and John Brooks didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

42' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves John Brooks with no other option than to blow for a foul.
42' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
41' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Tottenham is cautioned for aggressive play.
40' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) swings in a cross from the corner, but Guglielmo Vicario reads it well and gathers the ball.
39' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
37' Guglielmo Vicario reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) towards the roof of the net.
37' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes a direct free kick.

35' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. It's a free kick to West Ham, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
30' John Brooks interrupts the game. One of the players from West Ham won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
29' James Maddison (Tottenham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lukasz Fabianski intercepts the ball.
25' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) trips an opposition player and John Brooks signals a foul.
24' Great teamplay by Tottenham as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
21' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 3:3. 1:2 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
19' 1 - 1 It’s a GOAL! Kurt Zouma (West Ham) gets on the end of the corner and bundles the ball into the net with his body.
19' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is about to take a corner kick.
19' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. West Ham force their opponents to concede a corner.
17' James Maddison (Tottenham) delivers a fine ball into the box from a free kick. However, the opposition's defence make sure none of his teammates get a challenge in on the goalkeeper.
16' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) was too forceful with his tackle and John Brooks interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Tottenham are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
15' Timo Werner (Tottenham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
13' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls it and sends it straight at Lukasz Fabianski, who makes a comfortable save.
13' The Tottenham players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
10' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) picks up a pass and fires a powerful long-range shot which goes painfully close to the left post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
7' The resulting corner from Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is cleared by the defence.
7' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to West Ham.
7' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
7' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

5' 0 - 1 Timo Werner produces a sweet pass and picks out Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the middle of the net and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 0:1!

4' Mohammed Kudus sprays a pass out to Jarrod Bowen (West Ham), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
4' James Maddison (Tottenham) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
2' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) commits a rough foul. John Brooks stops the game and makes a call.
